We've got to elect politicians who will enact common sense laws, and we've got to help each other out in our communities, our neighborhoods, and our homes. So the point today is we've got to take care of each other, y'all. And we've got to get back to the times where we elect people who choose country over parties and people over politics. We've woken up again to sad days in America with more children dead. And it's on all of us to make sure that these kind of sad days, these days where we wake up and more of our children are dead, that they are fewer and far between. This has been the Sean Pittman Show. We'll see you in seven.
